column1: # Runtime voice: Mission Control reports with the crew history of the kerbal it talks to ({kerbal}). The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv.

column4: {kerbal}, es tu primer vuelo. Respira y disfruta.
column5: {kerbal}, it's your first flight. Breathe and enjoy it.

column4: {kerbal}, este es tu vuelo número {flight_no}. Ya eres de la casa.
column5: {kerbal}, this is flight number {flight_no} for you. You're family now.

column4: {kerbal}, con {missions} vuelos a la espalda, esto es rutina para ti.
column5: {kerbal}, with {missions} flights behind you, this is routine.

column4: {kerbal}, es tu primera vez en {body}. Saluda de nuestra parte.
column5: {kerbal}, it's your first time at {body}. Say hi for us.

column4: {kerbal}, ya has estado en {body} en {visits} viajes. Tú nos guías.
column5: {kerbal}, you've been to {body} on {visits} trips. You lead the way.

column4: {kerbal}, tú ya conoces {body}. Ya aterrizaste aquí antes.
column5: {kerbal}, you know {body}. You landed here before.

column4: {kerbal}, con nivel {stars} ya no hace falta que te digamos nada.
column5: {kerbal}, at level {stars} we don't need to tell you anything.
